build_discriminator_model: build a GAN discriminator model using Discriminator class with 192 feature filters and ResNet blocks
create_resnet_block: create a ResnetBlock with configurable input output channels and optional learned shortcut connection
run_discriminator_forward: run the Discriminator forward pass on a batch of 3-channel image tensors for classification
test_resnet_block_forward: test the ResnetBlock forward pass with input tensors and verify residual connection output
review_actvn_function: review the actvn function which applies ReLU activation to input tensors
